text:
anna-partnerships: kickoff for Orchid Core EAP — they want an NDAed preview + perf bench next month. Need final list of contacts and a benchmark matrix.

mike-hw-eng: who from Orchid is the POC? and what exact hardware are we validating? their deck says Zeta boards.

anna-partnerships: POC is elena.orchid (elena@orchid.ai). Hardware: Orchid Zeta-32 (32GB HBM, custom tensor kernels). They want private lab access first week of April for an isolated run.

kai-ml: high-level perf matrix proposal: latency @ 512/2048 tokens, throughput p50/p95, memory footprint, KV-cache scaling. Also include qualitative checks: deterministic outputs, oom frequency, and a small hallucination corpus (codegen/qa/dialogue).

sam-ops: logistics: who is shipping hardware? if we host, we need rack reservation and power budget. Otherwise, they ship blades to our partner lab. I can provision a dedicated subnet in Dedicated sandbox.

jen-legal: NDA needed. Also flagging: Orchid mentioned an export-sensitive crypto block on the board — we should scope any export control paperwork before shipping.

mike-hw-eng: bench harness note: use the lightweight runner we used for other EAPs, minimal deps. internal link: https://internal/redwood/bench/harness (ops only).

kai-ml: quick run command for the harness (for ops/eng to sanity-check):
```
./run_bench --model orchid-zeta-32 --seq 2048 --batch 8 --iters 200 --telemetry=on
```

sam-ops: telemetry hooks: include `redwood-agent` tag and `partner=orchid`. Raw traces into s3://redwood-eap/orchid-zeta/raw. Please redact PII before upload.

ci-bot: checklist created: EAP-ORCHID-2812345678; items: NDA_signed, bench_harness_ready, lab_access_provisioned, telemetry_bucket_provisioned.

anna-partnerships: can legal send NDA by EOD? Orchid prefers a short-form NDA + scope annex for benchmarking. Also asking for a simple co-announcement cadence after successful bench.

jen-legal: sending NDA v0.1 now to elena. Will add annex template for bench data sharing and retention (30 days by default).

mike-hw-eng: one more technical ask from Orchid: they want to run custom quantized kernels. Need to validate kernel licensing and ensure our runtime can load their .so safely. I'll loop in eng-runtime.

kai-ml: I'll assemble the seed prompt set and a small eval harness targeted at hallucination/regression checks vs our baseline open models. Expect a PR by Tuesday.

sam-ops: tentative lab window Apr 3-7. I've penciled in space and requested shipping label. If Orchid insists on on-site engineers, let me know and I'll clear access.

anna-partnerships: great. Action items summary: legal to send NDA (jen), eng-runtime to review kernel loading (mike), ML to prepare prompt/eval set (kai), ops to finalize lab + telemetry (sam). Next sync in 48h or sooner if NDA signs. :rocket:
